search.field.description: The label of the search screen's field, where the reader writes what to find.

search.clear.description: The button at the end of a search field that empties it.

search.hint.defaultMessage: {posts, select, yes {Personas por nombre o alias, etiquetas y publicaciones por sus palabras} other {Personas por nombre o alias, y etiquetas}}
search.hint.description: The hint under the search field: what it finds. posts is yes where the server searches posts too.

search.people.description: The title of the accounts a search found, and the tab of them.

search.hashtags.description: The title of the hashtags a search found, and the tab of them.

search.posts.description: The title of the posts a search found, and the tab of them.

search.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo hacer la búsqueda.
search.failed.description: When a search failed; Try again follows it.

search.retry.description: The action that asks a failed search again.

search.none.defaultMessage: No se encontró nada para «{q}». Prueba con otras palabras.
search.none.description: When a search found nothing of any kind. q is what the reader wrote.

search.tag_posts.description: How many posts carry a hashtag the search found, under its name.

search.looking_up.description: While the account of another server that the reader named by its handle or address is fetched. handle is what they wrote.

search.remote_none.defaultMessage: No se encontró ninguna cuenta en {handle}. Comprueba el alias.
search.remote_none.description: When the account of another server that the reader named by its handle or address was not found. handle is what they wrote.
